programs.title: Bloomberg Originals
programs.desc: "Bloomberg Originals" offers bold takes for curious minds on today's biggest topics; hosted by experts covering stories you haven't seen and viewpoints you haven't heard, you'll discover cinematic, data-led shows that investigate the intersection of business and culture; exploring every angle of climate change, technology, finance, sports and beyond, "Bloomberg Originals" is business as you've never seen it.

programs.title: The Circuit With Emily Chang
programs.desc: S05E02 Emily Chang meets 23andMe Institute Chief Executive Officer Anne Wojcicki for a discussion of the rise, fall and rebirth of the personal genetics company.

programs.title: Insight With Haslinda Amin
programs.desc: The definitive guide for global news audiences to get the complete picture on the story of the day, through probing interviews and nuanced conversations.

programs.title: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa
programs.desc: A spotlight on the fast paced growth and major deals happening across the Middle East and Africa; linking the market drivers from overnight in the US and across Asia into the region's trading day, with deep dive analysis of the top business, energy and geopolitical stories shaping the decisions of traders across the Middle East, Africa and beyond.

programs.title: Bloomberg Daybreak: Europe
programs.desc: From London, essential morning viewing to stay ahead of the day's market trends with news stories from the U.S. and Asia in the lead-up to the opening of European markets.

programs.title: Bloomberg The Opening Trade
programs.desc: "The Opening Trade" explores things to know as markets open across Europe; analysis that isn't available anywhere else, a break-down of the biggest stories of the day and top guests who have skin in the game.

programs.title: The Pulse with Francine Lacqua
programs.desc: "The Pulse With Francine Lacqua" is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics; based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.

programs.title: Bloomberg Brief
programs.desc: "Bloomberg Brief" delivers the market news, data and analysis viewers need to set their agendas.

programs.title: Bloomberg Surveillance
programs.desc: Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern have the economy and global markets "under surveillance"; their daily conversations with leaders and decision makers from Wall Street to Washington and beyond cover the latest in business, investment, and geopolitics; no other program better positions investors and executives for the trading day.

programs.title: Bloomberg Open Interest
programs.desc: Delivering the market-moving news anyone needs to know to get a jump start on the U.S. trading day.

programs.title: Bloomberg Tech
programs.desc: Bloomberg Tech is the only daily live technology program with a focus on breaking news, market-moving reporting and analysis of global technology companies and stories. The program brings the audience interviews from the biggest names in the business, offering in-depth analysis and critical insights.

programs.title: Bloomberg Real Yield
programs.desc: Guests from major bond companies join to give their insight and perspective on how to trade the global headlines.
